title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD DXF/DWG strict-import and converter-route crosswalk
scope: Inspect the current FreeCAD direct-DXF importer API, importer option handling, and configured DWG-to-DXF wrapper route
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 FreeCAD consumer qualification recipe without adding implementation findings or support claims
Keep the direct DXF importer and DWG converter-plus-importer route as distinct evidence gates

method.kind: Read-only review of current project-owned FreeCAD source/documentation and local plan inventory
method.limitations: FreeCAD main source is mutable and was reviewed as published on 2026-10-19 without pinning a commit or executing a matching build. The documentation repository is archived and is used only to identify candidate capability profiles. These source observations define qualification controls; they are not runtime results, libdxfrw defects, or support evidence. No external drawing or attachment was retrieved.

sources.revision: mutable main source inspected 2026-10-19; commit not pinned
sources.observed: Import.readDXF initializes IgnoreErrors to true, forwards the value to ImpExpDxfRead::DoRead, and returns importer statistics. Its optional positional arguments after the filename are document name, ignore-errors Boolean, and option-source path, so a caller can request strict behavior with Import.readDXF(path, document_name, False, option_source). This source fact does not establish runtime acceptance of any particular DXF.

sources.revision: mutable main source inspected 2026-10-19; commit not pinned
sources.observed: The importer selects an option source and records import settings including import mode, scaling, annotations, points, layout/paper-space handling, hidden blocks, layers, and colors. Its simple line-oriented PreScan counts values following literal group-code 0 lines and is not the complete parser or a source-record identity oracle. Import modes may aggregate shapes, so FreeCAD document-object count is not a DXF entity denominator.

sources.revision: mutable main source inspected 2026-10-19; commit not pinned
sources.observed: The DWG wrapper selects among configured LibreDWG, ODA, or QCAD converter commands before importing the produced DXF. These routes use different command/output profiles; the LibreDWG invocation does not explicitly set a target DXF version. The wrapper waits for process completion and uses output-path existence as a success condition in the inspected paths, which does not establish strict DXF validity, complete conversion, or native CAD acceptance.

sources.revision: mutable main documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; repository archived 2026-04-01
sources.observed: The capability page distinguishes the C++ and legacy Python DXF importers and describes different feature subsets, with DWG import mediated by a converter and no stock embedded ACIS/SAT reader. Because the documentation repository is archived and the page is not tied to the runtime build used in a qualification, it is only a candidate-profile reference.

plan_effect.existingOwner: PAR-07/S8 FreeCAD native consumer qualification; separate direct-DXF import and composed DWG-converter-to-DXF-import routes
changes: Require strict direct-DXF qualification to pass ignore_errors=false when the selected FreeCAD API supports it; label default/permissive application routes separately and retain diagnostics and importer statistics.

Pin the FreeCAD build, importer backend, option source, and relevant import settings; use an independently generated source identity manifest and predeclared geometry profile rather than PreScan or aggregate FreeCAD object counts.

For DWG qualification, record the exact configured converter/build/hash/command, process result and diagnostics, intermediate DXF hash and actual $ACADVER, then validate and import that intermediate as separate stages.
Keep FreeCAD native Linux and Windows runs at the existing composed qualification checkpoint; do not add external application runs to every implementation slice or change routine test cadence.
Preserve the existing fixture policy: repository-owned or locally generated samples only; no customer/issue drawings downloaded or committed.

implementationReadyChecks: For direct DXF, identify the exact FreeCAD build/platform and importer backend; invoke the native C++ importer through Import.readDXF(path, document_name, False, option_source), record the option source/settings, preserve diagnostics/statistics, and compare predeclared source identities and expected transformed geometry.

For DWG-to-FreeCAD, record the selected converter executable/build/hash and exact invocation; separately inspect exit status/diagnostics, intermediate DXF existence/hash/$ACADVER, strict parse disposition, and FreeCAD importer result.
Do not infer completeness from a returned document, output pathname, visible shape, importer PreScan, or aggregate object count; explicitly account for excluded/profile-inapplicable source records.
Run native FreeCAD qualification only at the existing composed platform gate, after relevant fast local checks; this research does not increase the full-suite or external-test frequency.
